<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XXVI.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|75 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=26|verse=6}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 3. Io. 12, 3.''}}* when IESVS vvas in Bethania in the house of Simon the Leper, {{verse|chapter=26|verse=7}}† there came to him a vvoman hauing an alabaster-boxe of pretious ointment, and povvred it out vpon his head as he sate at the table. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=8}}† And the Disciples seeing it, had indignation saying, Whereto is ‖ this vvast? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=9}}† for this might haue been sold for much, and giuen to the poore. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=10}}† And IESVS knovving it, said to them: Why do you molest this vvoman? for she hath vvrought a ‖ good vvorke vpon me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=11}}† For the poore you haue alvvayes vvith you: but me ‖ you haue not alvvayes. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=12}}† For she in povvring this ointment vpon my body: hath done it to burie me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=13}}† Amen I say to you, vvheresoeuer this Gospel shal be preached in the vvhole vvorld, that also vvhich she hath done, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Hereby we learne that the good workes of Saincts are to be recorded and set forth to their honour in the Church after their death. Whereof rise their holy daies and Cōmemorations.}}∷ shal be reported for a memorie of her. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=14}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 10. Lu. 22, 3.''}}* Then went one of the Tvvelue, vvhich vvas called Iudas Iscarioth, to the cheefe Priestes, {{verse|chapter=26|verse=15}}† and said to them, What vvil you giue me, and I vvil deliuer him vnto you? But they appointed vnto him thirtie peeces of siluer. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=16}}† And from thenceforth he sought opportunitie to betray him.

{{verse|chapter=26|verse=17}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=MAVNDY thursday.}}And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 12. Lu. 22, 7.''}}* the first day of the Azymes the Disciples came to IESVS, saying, Where vvilt thou that vve prepare for thee to eate the Pasche? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=18}}† But IESVS said, Goe ye into the citie to a certaine man: and say to him, The Maister saith, My time is at hand, vvith thee do I make the Pasche vvith my Disciples. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=19}}† And the Disciples did as IESVS appointed them, and they prepared the Pasche. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=20}}† But vvhen it vvas euen, he sate downe vvith his ‖ tvvelue Disciples. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=21}}† And vvhile they vvere eating, he said: Amen I say to you, that one of you shal betray me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=22}}† And they being very sad, began euery one to say, Is it I Lord? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=23}}† But he ansvvering said, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 40, 10.''}}* He that dippeth his hand vvith me in the dish, he shal betray me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=24}}† The Sonne of man in deede goeth as it is vvritten of him: but vvo be to that man, by vvhom the Sonne of man shal be betrayed. It vvere good for him, if that man had not been borne. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=25}}† And Iudas that betrayed him, ansvvering said, Is it I Rabbi? He saith to him, Thou hast said.

{{verse|chapter=26|verse=26}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1. Cor. 11, 24.''}}* vvhiles they vvere at supper, IESVS ‖ tooke bread, and ‖ blessed, and brake: and he gaue to his Disciples, and said, Take ye, and eate: ‖ THIS IS ‖ MY BODY. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=27}}† And taking the chalice, ‖ he gaue thankes: and gaue to them, saying: Drinke {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ See the margent note ''Mar. 14, 23.''}}∷ ye al of this. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=28}}† For THIS IS ‖ MY BLOVD OF<noinclude>{{rh||K ij|THE}}</noinclude>
